column1: # One row per ruled_n in 1..=244, ascending, tab-separated, four fields:
#   ruled_n      the RULED item number on wayfinder map pardosa-jn1.
#   disposition  SPEC-BEARING (the ruling lands in >= 1 numbered clause)
#                or MAP-GOVERNANCE (it governs the map, the ADR corpus, bd hygiene,
#                citation audits, or the clean-room transfer, and has no clause here).
#   clause_ids   semicolon-separated clause ids for SPEC-BEARING rows; "-" otherwise.
#   note         short note for SPEC-BEARING rows; for MAP-GOVERNANCE rows, the reason,

column4: Mechanism stated in pardosa's own terms; no compliance claim, obligation rests with the consumer.
Erasure scoped to the artefact a migration writes; the artefact read is the consumer's to dispose.
Refusal posture: guarantees stop at the pardosa layer. Backend-split migration-manager half is layer-4/5 and lands in a later slice.

Verdict discipline only: indeterminate never folds into death. NOTE for the vocabulary slice: the ruling labels the verdict THREE-VALUED but enumerates two variants; the variant set is jn1.29's to state, not stated here.
The transfer test, stated normatively. Assumption named: the ruling left the test's document status unruled, and the document admits no non-normative slot.
Draws the boundary between this map and the clean-room transfer map by kind of question. It governs which map rules what, and has no clause in a library specification.
Pruning ships at 1.0 via the migration policy; no separate log-rewrite entry point; compaction policy deferred and kept distinct from the permanent refusal in C3.2.
Scope half only: wire shape and field encodings belong to the format specification. The operator-label design half is layer-6 and lands in a later slice.
Pair-movement requirement stated with its named failures; atomicity and tooling both refused.
Correlation deferred to W3C Trace Context; pardosa carries nothing natively and the spec states the deferral.

Ratified definition text carried verbatim. OPEN ESCALATION pardosa-8q05: its per-fiber narrowing was adopted to avoid pre-empting jn1.54, which has since contracted the total order in C3.8; not self-resolved.
Multi-dragline split is across artefacts; pardosa never partitions within one, and orders nothing between two.
Order existence and replay determinism contracted; order content refused. See open escalation pardosa-8q05 against C2.1's narrower definition.
Event kind is first-class pardosa vocabulary a stranger is taught, not merely a constraint on the payload type.
The fiber's ordered same-fiber series is the enabling affordance, already promised; nothing further owed at 1.0.
Fixes whether PAR ADRs are living documents or immutable-plus-supersession. It governs this effort's own ADR corpus and record-keeping, not the library's behaviour.
Tombstone read at migration only, keeping the no-query-surface refusal alive.
Envelope shape stays with this specification; the byte container's version belongs to the format specification. Never conflated.
